content: Health-check conventions 2026: separate liveness (/health, /healthz) - process alive, no dependency calls, cheap; from readiness (/ready, /readyz) - checks deps, 503 on failure. Load-balancer probes key off HTTP status (200 vs 503), body secondary but common minimal shape {'status':'ok'|'pass', 'uptime': seconds-since-start, optional timestamp/version}. Liveness must be I/O-free and cached; probe interval 5-10s, failure threshold 3-5. Requirement here (GET /health -> status+uptime) maps to the liveness contract; optional readiness can later check market_state.json existence/freshness. Health endpoints typically unauthenticated but network-restricted.
